description: HEROES (plan section 8.3). One entry per path, committed before that hero is generated. A hero's primary seed appears in no other fixed set. No hero seed is chosen yet (D26 is pending): the list is empty.

entry_schema.name: hero name
entry_schema.seed: primary seed (integer); must not appear in any other fixed set
entry_schema.control_seeds: optional same-prompt controls (for example 4242 for the Q2 DM hero under D26 (b))
entry_schema.expected_requests: list, in the run.py request vocabulary
entry_schema.declared_out_of_scope: requests declared out of scope BEFORE generation, each with a reason; waivers on a hero are 0 unless declared here
entry_schema.reference_set: stock maps used for comparison (ids only)

evidence_plan.native_routes: predeclared routes for native movement trials

entry_schema.committed: date the entry was committed, before generation
